#!/bin/bash -ex
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> START <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o get-docker.sh
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> TWO <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
sudo sh get-docker.sh
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> THREE <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
sudo apt install --assume-yes docker-compose
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> FOUR <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
sudo apt install --assume-yes unzip
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> FIVE <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
curl "https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip" -o "awscliv2.zip"
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> SIX <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
unzip awscliv2.zip
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> SEVEN <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
sudo ./aws/install
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> EIGHT <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
mkdir -p ./valheim-server/config
mkdir -p ./backups-ec2
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> NINE <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
mkdir -p ./valheim-server/data
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> TEN <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
cd ./valheim-server/
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> ELEVEN <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
aws s3 cp s3://gimboid-valheim/valheim.env ./valheim-server/valheim.env
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> TWELVE <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
aws s3 cp s3://gimboid-valheim/docker-compose.yml ./docker-compose.yml
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> THIRTEEN <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
pwd; ls -a
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> FOURTEEN <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
aws cp s3://gimboid-valheim/backups/worlds-20220224-230004.zip ./backups-ec2/worlds-20220224-230004.zip
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> FIFTEEN <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
sudo docker-compose up
